1.web: Jesus said these things, and lifting up his eyes to heaven, he said, “Father, the time has come. Glorify your Son, that your Son may also glorify you;
1.asv: These things spake Jesus; and lifting up his eyes to heaven, he said, Father, the hour is come; glorify thy Son, that the Son may glorify thee:

2.web: even as you gave him authority over all flesh, he will give eternal life to all whom you have given him.
2.asv: even as thou gavest him authority over all flesh, that to all whom thou hast given him, he should give eternal life.

3.web: This is eternal life, that they should know you, the only true God, and him whom you sent, Jesus Christ.
3.asv: And this is life eternal, that they should know thee the only true God, and him whom thou didst send, even Jesus Christ.

4.web: I glorified you on the earth. I have accomplished the work which you have given me to do.
4.asv: I glorified thee on the earth, having accomplished the work which thou hast given me to do.

5.web: Now, Father, glorify me with your own self with the glory which I had with you before the world existed.
5.asv: And now, Father, glorify thou me with thine own self with the glory which I had with thee before the world was.

6.web: I revealed your name to the people whom you have given me out of the world. They were yours, and you have given them to me. They have kept your word.
6.asv: I manifested thy name unto the men whom thou gavest me out of the world: thine they were, and thou gavest them to me; and they have kept thy word.

7.web: Now they have known that all things whatever you have given me are from you,
7.asv: Now they know that all things whatsoever thou hast given me are from thee:

8.web: for the words which you have given me I have given to them, and they received them, and knew for sure that I came from you, and they have believed that you sent me.
8.asv: for the words which thou gavest me I have given unto them; and they received them, and knew of a truth that I came forth from thee, and they believed that thou didst send me.

9.web: I pray for them. I don’t pray for the world, but for those whom you have given me, for they are yours.
9.asv: I pray for them: I pray not for the world, but for those whom thou hast given me; for they are thine:

10.web: All things that are mine are yours, and yours are mine, and I am glorified in them.
10.asv: and all things that are mine are thine, and thine are mine: and I am glorified in them.

11.web: I am no more in the world, but these are in the world, and I am coming to you. Holy Father, keep them through your name which you have given me, that they may be one, even as we are.
11.asv: And I am no more in the world, and these are in the world, and I come to thee. Holy Father, keep them in thy name which thou hast given me, that they may be one, even as we are.

12.web: While I was with them in the world, I kept them in your name. Those whom you have given me I have kept. None of them is lost, except the son of destruction, that the Scripture might be fulfilled.
12.asv: While I was with them, I kept them in thy name which thou hast given me: and I guarded them, and not one of them perished, but the son of perdition; that the scripture might be fulfilled.

13.web: But now I come to you, and I say these things in the world, that they may have my joy made full in themselves.
13.asv: But now I come to thee; and these things I speak in the world, that they may have my joy made full in themselves.

14.web: I have given them your word. The world hated them, because they are not of the world, even as I am not of the world.
14.asv: I have given them thy word; and the world hated them, because they are not of the world, even as I am not of the world.

15.web: I pray not that you would take them from the world, but that you would keep them from the evil one.
15.asv: I pray not that thou shouldest take them from the world, but that thou shouldest keep them from the evil one.

16.web: They are not of the world even as I am not of the world.
16.asv: They are not of the world, even as I am not of the world.

17.web: Sanctify them in your truth. Your word is truth.
17.asv: Sanctify them in the truth: thy word is truth.

18.web: As you sent me into the world, even so I have sent them into the world.
18.asv: As thou didst send me into the world, even so sent I them into the world.

19.web: For their sakes I sanctify myself, that they themselves also may be sanctified in truth.
19.asv: And for their sakes I sanctify myself, that they themselves also may be sanctified in truth.

20.web: Not for these only do I pray, but for those also who believe in me through their word,
20.asv: Neither for these only do I pray, but for them also that believe on me through their word;

21.web: that they may all be one; even as you, Father, are in me, and I in you, that they also may be one in us; that the world may believe that you sent me.
21.asv: that they may all be one; even as thou, Father, art in me, and I in thee, that they also may be in us: that the world may believe that thou didst send me.

22.web: The glory which you have given me, I have given to them; that they may be one, even as we are one;
22.asv: And the glory which thou hast given me I have given unto them; that they may be one, even as we are one;

23.web: I in them, and you in me, that they may be perfected into one; that the world may know that you sent me, and loved them, even as you loved me.
23.asv: I in them, and thou in me, that they may be perfected into one; that the world may know that thou didst send me, and lovedst them, even as thou lovedst me.

24.web: Father, I desire that they also whom you have given me be with me where I am, that they may see my glory, which you have given me, for you loved me before the foundation of the world.
24.asv: Father, I desire that they also whom thou hast given me be with me where I am, that they may behold my glory, which thou hast given me: for thou lovedst me before the foundation of the world.

25.web: Righteous Father, the world hasn’t known you, but I knew you; and these knew that you sent me.
25.asv: O righteous Father, the world knew thee not, but I knew thee; and these knew that thou didst send me;

26.web: I made known to them your name, and will make it known; that the love with which you loved me may be in them, and I in them.”
26.asv: and I made known unto them thy name, and will make it known; that the love wherewith thou lovedst me may be in them, and I in them.
